description: Reports and controls the pull request gate (gatekeepers/pr) for the core_dump GitHub repository:
whether its service is running, and for each open PR whether it is blocked
(build, tests, documentation, or a quiz waiting, with its link) or may merge.
With action history it lists past assessments (quizzes)
with their pull request, time, outcome and attempts.
With action start it starts the gate's own service (pr-gate) when it is not running.
Only the user can stop or restart the gate.

params.name: action
params.description: status (default): open pull requests; history: past assessments; start: start the gate's service if it is not running

params.name: pr
params.description: Only this pull request number (for status or history); omit it for all
